messages:
Maria (CSM): Hey team — cutover window tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC for Nimbus private deploy. Need final signoffs on networking, IAM trust, and KMS rotation plan. Customer expects no data-plane downtime.
Alex (Eng-Infra): Saw the runbook, thanks. Quick question: are we forwarding S3/ES audit logs to their SIEM over a private path or using a log forwarder in their VPC? Need that clarified for the firewall rules.
Tom (Cloud Infra): We're forwarding via a logshipper in their VPC over a VPC endpoint peering + private link to their collector. That means egress to their collector CIDR only (10.23.45.0/24) on 443. @Kevin (Network) can you confirm we can apply the egress rule in prod during the window?
Kevin (Network): Confirmed for staging — egress rule created there. I'll mirror to prod during the cutover window after final signoff. Rule: allow tcp/443 to 10.23.45.0/24 from subnet-xyz.
Rachel (Customer): FYI, our security team needs KMS CMKs to be HSM-backed and requires an auditable key rotation proof. Also they want a copy of the key policy before go-live.
Alex (Eng-Infra): We tested HSM-backed CMKs in the private package. Key rotation will be an automated rotation schedule but we can do an explicit rotation during cutover if requested. Key policy draft uploaded: https://redwood.corp/drive/nimbus-kms-policy (please review).
Maria (CSM): I'll chase our legal/security for formal sign-off. Note: if the key policy signature isn't in place 48h before cutover, this becomes a schedule risk and could push the cutover which may impact their renewal milestones. Marking as renewal-risk flag.
Tom (Cloud Infra): Also we need the customer's IAM audit role trust established so our observability account can assume arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/NimbusAudit. Sample trust JSON pasted below for their IAM team to import:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::555555555555:role/RedwoodObservability"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {}
    }
  ]
}
```
Kevin (Network): One more note — the customer's proxy does mTLS. We need cert thumbprint to allow in peering policy. Who owns that on the customer side?
Rachel (Customer): I can get the cert thumbprint today, will share in this thread. Also asking if audit logs retention will be 90 or 180 days — they prefer 180.
Alex (Eng-Infra): We can set retention to 180 days for audit indexes, but that increases storage delta — Redwood billing will show an estimated +12% on logs for 180d. I'll add that to the cutover cost note.
Maria (CSM): Actions list: 1) Rachel to share cert thumbprint (today). 2) Customer to sign key policy (by T-48h) — Rachel to escalate. 3) Kevin to schedule prod egress rule in window. 4) Alex/Tom to run a canary in staging 1h before cutover and validate audit forwarding. 5) DeployBot to run incremental dry-run.
DeployBot: Canary run queued: commit abc123 -> staging cluster 3. Canary will emit sample audit logs to the customer's collector. Link: https://deploys.redwood/canary/abc123
Alex (Eng-Infra): Plan for rollback: if audit forwarder fails, we will revert network changes and failover to host-based retention (local S3 bucket snapshot). That is in the runbook step 7.
Maria (CSM): Customer asked for a short runbook copy they can present to their SOC. I'll extract the 6 key steps and post here by EOD.
Tom (Cloud Infra): Headcount check for cutover: need 1x on-call infra eng, 1x network, 1x CSM, and SRE standby. Can someone confirm?
Kevin (Network): I'll be on-call for network changes.
Alex (Eng-Infra): I'll handle runtime and can run the canary.
Rachel (Customer): I'll confirm SOC presence and share their on-call. Also flagging audit retention and legal sign-off as blockers until resolved.
Maria (CSM): Thanks. If we don't have key-policy signed and cert thumbprint by 20:00 UTC tonight we should push the cutover back 24h. Please call out blockers asap. :warning: :thumbsup:
Kevin (Network): Noted. Will update once prod rule scheduled.
DeployBot: Canary started at 3309998920 -> logs available: https://logs.redwood/canary/abc123 (sample events present).
Alex (Eng-Infra): Canary shows 3 sample events forwarded to their collector successfully. @Rachel please confirm your SOC sees them.
Rachel (Customer): SOC confirmed receipt of sample events. Cert thumbprint inbound in DM. Signing progress: legal asking for one small clause edit, pinging them now.
Maria (CSM): Great — keep updates here. I'll post the shortened SOC-facing runbook in 30m. If anything changes we'll reconvene 2h before the window.
Maria (CSM): (follow-up) Short runbook posted: https://redwood.corp/drive/nimbus-soc-runbook — please review and ack.
